title: G6 not receiving data when phone locked
symptom: Using Dexcom G6 and Galaxy S9+ with Android 9.0 and xDrip+, the app receives no data after the phone has had the screen locked for a while. It does successfully receive data the rest of the time.
fix: Updating xDrip to the nightly build from April 1 seems to fix the issue with the screen lock on.
evidence_quote: I updated xDrip to the nightly build from April 1 and it seems to be working with the screen lock on again.
